items.title: 9.1 Nizam-e-hazma (digestive system) ki banawat aur kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 9.1, printed pages 202-212.

blocks.text: Digestion (hazma) woh amal hai jis mein jism khane ko chhote chhote hisson mein tod deta hai taake woh jazb ho sakein (absorb ho kar khoon mein ja sakein). Digestion is liye zaroori hai ke khana energy mein aur un cheezon (raw materials) mein badle jo jism ki growth (barhne), repair (marammat) aur rozmarra ke kaamon ke liye chahiye. Yeh immune system (beemari se bachane wala nizam) ko madad deta hai, zaroori nutrients (ghizai ajza) deta hai aur sehat theek rakhta hai. Achha digestion nutrients ki kami nahi hone deta, metabolism ko chalata hai aur energy barqarar rakhta hai, is liye zindagi ke liye bohat zaroori hai.

Insaan ka digestive system do hisson se bana hai: gastrointestinal (GI) tract aur accessory (madadgar) digestive organs. GI tract ek lambi nali hai jo munh se anus (paakhane ka rasta) tak jati hai. Is mein oral cavity (munh), pharynx (gala), oesophagus (khane ki nali), stomach (meda), small intestine (chhoti aant) aur large intestine (badi aant) shamil hain. Accessory organs yeh hain: salivary glands (thook banane wale glands), liver (jigar), gallbladder (pitta) aur pancreas (lablaba).

blocks.alt: Sar aur dhar ke khaake mein munh se anus tak hazmi nali: Tongue, Salivary glands, Pharynx, Oesophagus, Stomach, Small intestine (Duodenum, Jejunum, Ileum) aur Colon (Transverse, Ascending, Descending colon), saath Cecum, Appendix, Rectum aur Anus. Liver, Gallbladder aur Pancreas maide ke paas; Common bile duct aur Pancreatic duct duodenum mein khulte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: Insani nizam-e-hazma (kitab ki Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khane ka raasta tarteeb se: munh, pharynx, oesophagus, stomach, duodenum, jejunum, ileum, phir cecum se ascending, transverse aur descending colon, rectum aur anus. Liver, gallbladder aur pancreas nali ka hissa nahi; yeh apne juices ducts (naliyon) ke zariye duodenum mein dalte hain.
Oral cavity (munh)

Munh khulte hi jo khali jagah (cavity) hai use oral cavity kehte hain. Hont (lips) skeletal muscle ke bane hain, in mein khoon ki bohat si naliyan aur mehsoos karne wali bohat si nerve endings hoti hain. Hont chabate waqt khane ko munh mein rokte hain aur bolne mein awaz ko badalne (phonation) mein bhi kaam aate hain. Oral cavity ke aham kaam yeh hain:

Khane ka intikhab (selection of food): zaban (tongue) muscle ki bani hai aur apne taste buds (zaiqa mehsoos karne wale hisson) se khana chunne mein kaam aati hai. Khana munh mein aata hai to us ka zaiqa chakha aur use chhoo kar mehsoos kiya jata hai. Agar zaiqa ya boo buri ho, ya khane mein haddi ya mitti jaisi sakht cheez ho, to use bahar nikal diya jata hai. Soonghne aur dekhne ki hiss bhi khana chunne mein madad karti hai.

Mechanical digestion (khane ko tod kar chhota karna): daant khane ko chaba kar todte hain; ise mastication (chabana) kehte hain. Chabane se khana chhote, sambhalne ke qabil tukdon mein badal jata hai aur us ki surface area (bahar ki satah) barh jati hai, is liye enzymes behtar kaam karte hain.

Chemical digestion (enzymes se hazma): chabane ke saath saath salivary glands apna juice, saliva (thook), munh mein dalte hain. Talu (palate), zaban aur gaal chabaye hue khane ko saliva mein milate hain. Salivary glands ke teen jode hain: sublingual glands (zaban ke neeche), submaxillary glands (jabdon ke peeche) aur parotid glands (kaanon ke aage).

Saliva mein pani aur mucus (chikna madda) hota hai jo khane ko geela aur chikna banata hai. Is mein bicarbonate ions bhi hote hain jo munh ke chemicals ka asar halka (buffer) karte hain, aur thiocyanate ions jo jaraseem (microorganisms) ko maarte hain. Kitab ke mutabiq taaza saliva alkaline (pH 8) hota hai, magar jaldi CO₂ kho kar pH 6 ka ho jata hai. Saliva mein ek enzyme, salivary amylase, bhi hota hai jo polysaccharides (starch aur glycogen) ko kuch had tak disaccharide (maltose) mein tod deta hai. Munh mein mechanical aur chemical digestion ke baad khana ek chhota, geela gola ban jata hai jise bolus kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Sar ka pehlu se manzar. Parotid gland kaan ke aage aur neeche hai aur us ki nali aage munh tak jati hai; Submaxillary gland jabre ke kone ke neeche; Sublingual gland zaban ke neeche munh ke farsh mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2: Salivary glands ki jagah (kitab ki Figure 9.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen jode yaad rakhein: parotid (kaan ke aage, sab se bada), submaxillary (jabde ke neeche) aur sublingual (zaban ke neeche). Teenon ka juice, saliva, naliyon ke zariye munh mein aata hai.
Pharynx (gala)
Pharynx munh ke peeche wali khali jagah hai. Yeh khane aur saans dono ka sanjha (common) rasta hai. Bolus ko munh ke peeche dhakela jata hai aur pharynx se nigla jata hai.

Khana nigalna (swallowing): nigalte waqt zaban upar aur peeche ki taraf munh ki chhat (talu) se dabti hai, is se bolus munh ke peeche chala jata hai. Soft palate (naram talu) bhi upar uth kar pharynx ki pichhli deewar se lag jata hai. In harkaton se naak aur pharynx ke beech ka rasta band ho jata hai. Usi waqt larynx (awaz ka dabba) upar uthta hai, epiglottis (cartilage ka ek dhakkan) neeche aata hai aur trachea (saans ki nali) ka munh band kar deta hai. Is tarah bolus trachea ke upar se guzar kar oesophagus mein chala jata hai.

blocks.title: Pehle apni marzi se, phir khud ba khud
blocks.text: Nigalna shuru karna hamari marzi (voluntary) se hota hai, magar jab khana munh ke peeche pohanch jaye to nigalna khud ba khud (automatic) hota hai.

blocks.alt: Sar aur gardan ke teen section. Pehla: Soft palate pharynx ki pichhli deewar se laga, Bolus munh ke peeche, aur Tongue upar aur peeche jati hai. Doosra: Epiglottis glottis ko band karne ke liye jhukti hai aur Larynx upar uthta hai; bolus saans ki nali ke upar se guzarta hai. Teesra: bolus oesophagus mein, Soft palate dheela aur Epiglottis wapas uthti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3: Khoorak nigalna (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do darwaze band hote hain taake khana ghalat raste na jaye: soft palate naak ka rasta band karta hai aur epiglottis trachea ka munh dhak deti hai. Bolus guzar jaye to dono wapas khul jate hain aur saans phir chalne lagta hai.
Oesophagus (khane ki nali)

Nigalne ke baad khana ek nali mein jata hai jise oesophagus kehte hain. Yeh pharynx ko stomach se jodti hai. Saliva ka jo kaam munh mein shuru hua tha woh oesophagus mein bhi chalta rehta hai. Bade insaan mein oesophagus taqreeban 25 cm lamba hota hai aur is ka neeche wala sira stomach mein khulta hai. Khana peristalsis ke zariye oesophagus se neeche stomach tak jata hai. Oesophagus se stomach mein khane ka jana lower oesophageal sphincter ya cardiac sphincter (muscle ka ek chhalla) control karta hai. Yeh khane ke dabao (pressure) se khulta hai, aur stomach ka khana wapas oesophagus mein aane se bhi rokta hai.

blocks.alt: Lambi nali, Oesophagus, jis mein Bolus hai, Cardiac sphincter ke zariye Stomach mein khulti hai; maide ke neeche baen sire se Small intestine shuru hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4: Oesophagus aur us ke jor (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cardiac sphincter oesophagus ke neeche wale sire par muscle ka chhalla hai. Khane ka dabao aane par yeh khulta hai aur baad mein band ho kar stomach ka tezabi khana wapas oesophagus mein nahi jane deta.
Alimentary canal ki harkat (motility)
Alimentary canal (khane ki poori nali) mein do qisam ki harkatein hoti hain.

Peristalsis: alimentary canal ki deewaron ke smooth muscles mein sukadne (contraction) ki lehrein ek tarteeb se aage barhti hain. Peristalsis khane ko daba kar oesophagus aur nali ke baqi hisson mein aage dhakelti hai.

Segmentation: chhoti aur badi aant mein bhi smooth muscles ke chhalle hote hain jo baar baar sukadte aur dheele hote hain. Is se ek hi jagah aage peeche harkat hoti hai jise segmentation kehte hain. Yeh harkat khane ko digestive juices mein achhi tarah milati hai aur absorption (jazb hona) behtar karti hai.
Antiperistalsis

Kabhi kabhi peristalsis ulti chal padti hai; ise antiperistalsis kehte hain. Is mein khana aanton se wapas stomach aur munh ki taraf dhakela jata hai aur ulti (vomiting) ho jati hai. Is ke baraks hunger contractions (bhook ki harkatein) woh peristalsis hai jo khoon mein glucose kam hone par shuru hoti hai, aur is se pait mein bhook ki takleef deh hiss (hunger pangs) hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Bolus wali oesophagus: bolus ke peeche azlat ka chhalla sukra hua (Muscles contracted) aur aage ka hissa dheela (Muscles relaxed); bara teer neeche Peristalsis dikhata hai. Oesophagus Cardiac sphincter se Stomach mein khulti hai, maide ke saath mura Peristalsis teer, aur maida Pyloric sphincter se Small intestine mein khulta hai jahan chhalle Segmentation movements dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.5: Peristalsis aur segmentation (kitab ki Figure 9.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peristalsis mein bolus ke peeche muscle sukadti hai aur aage dheeli hoti hai, is liye bolus aage dhakela jata hai, jaise toothpaste ki tube dabana. Segmentation mein aant ke chhalle ek hi jagah baari baari sukadte aur dheele hote hain, is se khana aage nahi jata balke achhi tarah milta hai.
Stomach (meda)

Stomach muscle ka bana, khinchne wala (elastic) J ki shakal ka thaila hai jo oesophagus ke baad aur duodenum se pehle hai. Yeh pait (abdominal cavity) mein baen (left) taraf, diaphragm ke bilkul neeche hota hai. Is ke teen hisse hain: cardiac portion oesophagus ke foran baad; fundus portion cardiac portion ke ek taraf; aur pyloric portion cardiac portion ke neeche. Jab oesophagus se peristalsis ki lehar cardiac sphincter tak aati hai to woh khul jata hai aur khana stomach mein chala jata hai.

Mechanical digestion: stomach ki deewar mein wahi tahein (layers) hain jo nali ke baqi hisson mein hain. Sab se bahar serosa, darmiyan mein smooth muscles. Stomach mein muscles ki teen tahein hain: bahar longitudinal (lambai mein), darmiyan circular (gol) aur andar oblique (tirchi). Andar ki do tahein submucosa aur mucosa hain. Stomach ki muscles zor se sukadti hain, khane ko mathti (churning) hain aur stomach ke juices mein milati hain. Kitab ke mutabiq in harkaton se itni garmi bhi banti hai ke thos charbi (fats) pighal jati hai.

blocks.title: Heartburn (seene ki jalan)
blocks.text: Kabhi stomach ka tezabi chyme wapas oesophagus mein aa jata hai. Is se seene mein dard wali jalan hoti hai, jise pyrosis ya heartburn kehte hain.

Chemical digestion: stomach ki mucosa mein bohat si nali jaisi gastric glands hain. Yeh glands gehre gaddhon, gastric pits, ke zariye mucosa mein khulti hain. Har gastric gland mein epithelial cells aur teen qisam ke juice banane wale cells hote hain:

items: Mucous cells: yeh mucus banate hain, ek gaadha chikna madda jo stomach ke andar ki deewar ko dhak kar use HCl aur enzymes se bachata hai.

Parietal (oxyntic) cells: yeh hydrochloric acid (HCl) banate hain. HCl stomach ke khane ka pH taqreeban 2-3 kar deta hai (bohat tezabi). HCl khane ko naram karta hai, pepsinogen ko active karta hai aur jaraseem ko maarta hai.
Chief cells: yeh enzyme pepsinogen banate hain.

blocks.title: Bachon mein rennin
blocks.text: Chhote bachon (infants) ke gastric juice mein rennin enzyme zyada hota hai. Yeh doodh ke proteins ko jama deta (coagulate karta) hai aur doodh ko jaldi chhoti aant mein jane nahi deta. Is der se doosre enzymes ko doodh ke proteins hazam karne ka waqt mil jata hai.

blocks.alt: J ki shakal ka maida: Cardiac portion par oesophagus dakhil hoti hai, gumbad-numa Fundus portion, aur Pyloric portion jo chhalle par khatam hota hai. Kati hui patti deewar ki tahein dikhati hai: Serosa, Longitudinal muscles, Circular muscles, Oblique muscles, Submucosa aur Mucosa. Teer Mucosa ke tukre tak jata hai jis mein gastric glands hain, phir ek Gastric pit aur Gastric gland tak; teer Epithelial, Mucous, Parietal aur Chief cell dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.6: Maida; bairooni aur andarooni banawat (kitab ki Figure 9.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Andar se bahar: mucosa, submucosa, muscles ki teen tahein (oblique, circular, longitudinal) aur serosa. Mucosa ke gaddhon (gastric pits) mein glands khulti hain: mucous cells mucus, parietal cells HCl aur chief cells pepsinogen banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 9.6 par 'Pyrolic portion' chhapa hai; sahi naam pyloric portion hai, jo yahan likha gaya hai.

Gastric glands ke saare juices mil kar gastric juice kehlate hain. Bolus stomach mein aata hai to gastric glands gastric juice nikalti hain. HCl ke H⁺ ions pepsinogen ko pepsin mein badal dete hain. Pepsin proteins ko tod kar polypeptides aur peptides banata hai. Khane ke taqreeban teen se chaar ghante baad stomach ka khana achhi tarah mil kar aadha patla, tezabi madda ban jata hai jise chyme kehte hain. Pyloric sphincter chyme ko thoda thoda kar ke chhoti aant mein bhejta hai.
Gastric juice nikalne ka control (regulation)

Gastric juice ka nikalna nervous system (nerves) aur hormones dono control karte hain. Khane ki khushboo, shakal ya sirf khayal se dimagh ka medulla gastric glands ko paigham bhejta hai aur woh thoda sa gastric juice nikalti hain. Jab khana stomach mein pohanchta hai to stomach phailta (distension) hai aur us ke andar pH kam hota hai; is se zyada juice nikalta hai aur muscles zor se sukadti hain.

blocks.title: Stomach apni hifazat kaise karta hai
blocks.text: Agar koi hifazat na ho to stomach ki mucosa acid aur pepsin se kharab ho sakti hai. Is ki hifazat do tarah hoti hai: gaadhe mucus se, aur bicarbonate se jo acid ko neutralize (be asar) karta hai.

Khane mein proteins hon to stomach ki mucosa ke khaas endocrine cells ek hormone, gastrin, chhodte hain. Gastrin khoon ke zariye gastric glands tak jata hai aur unhen zyada gastric juice banane aur nikalne ko kehta hai. Jab khana stomach se chhoti aant mein chala jata hai to somatostatin naam ka hormone HCl ka nikalna rok deta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen qataron ka flowchart. Neeli qatar (nervous control): Sight, smell or thought of food se Medulla of brain, phir Gastric glands secrete gastric juice. Narangi qatar (hormonal control): Food (proteins) in the stomach se Endocrine cells release gastrin, phir Gastrin reaches gastric glands through blood, aur teer upar gastric glands tak. Surmai qatar: Food moves on to the small intestine se Somatostatin, phir HCl secretion stops.
blocks.caption: Gastric juice ka qaboo: asabi aur hormonal (hamara apna flowchart; kitab is jagah koi figure nahin chhapti).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gastric juice do tarah control hota hai: khane ki khushboo ya khayal se dimagh ka medulla glands ko paigham bhejta hai (nervous control), aur stomach mein proteins aane par gastrin hormone khoon ke zariye glands ko mazeed juice banane ko kehta hai (hormonal control). Khana aage chala jaye to somatostatin HCl band kar deta hai.
Small intestine (chhoti aant)

Yeh alimentary canal ka sab se lamba hissa hai. Yeh stomach ke baad shuru ho kar badi aant par khatam hoti hai. Bade insaan mein is ki chaurai (diameter) taqreeban 2-3 cm aur lambai 6 m hoti hai. Chhoti aant mein har qisam ke khane ka aakhri digestion bhi hota hai aur hazam shuda khana khoon aur lymph mein jazb bhi hota hai. Is ke teen hisse hain: duodenum, jejunum aur ileum.
Duodenum
Pehla 20–25 cm lamba hissa duodenum hai. Is ka kaam khane ka digestion hai. Is mein glands bhi hain jo bicarbonate wala alkaline juice banati hain. Duodenum mein do bade juices aate hain.

a- Pancreatic juice: yeh pancreas ka juice hai jo duodenum mein aata hai. Bicarbonate ki wajah se yeh thoda alkaline (pH 8) hota hai aur chyme ki tezabiyat (acidity) khatam karta hai. Is ke aham enzymes yeh hain:

items: Pancreatic amylase: polysaccharides ko maltose aur kuch glucose tak tod deta hai.
Trypsinogen: yeh inactive (be kaar) shakal mein nikalta hai. Duodenum ki deewar ka enzyme enterokinase ise trypsin mein badal deta hai, aur trypsin proteins ko polypeptides mein todta hai.
Chymotrypsin aur carboxypeptidase: proteins ko chhote peptides aur phir amino acids mein todte hain.
Pancreatic lipase: lipids (charbi) ko glycerol aur fatty acids mein todta hai.
Pancreatic nucleases: DNA aur RNA ko nucleotides mein todte hain.

blocks.title: Bile kyun zaroori hai
blocks.text: Fats pani mein hal nahi hote, is liye pancreatic juice ka lipase un par aasani se kaam nahi kar sakta. Bile salts detergent (sabun) ki tarah kaam karte hain: fats ko chhote qatron (droplets) mein todte hain aur qatron ko alag alag rakhte hain.

b- Bile: yeh liver ka juice hai. Nikalne se pehle yeh gallbladder mein jama rehta hai. Is mein salts hote hain jo fats ko emulsify karte hain, yani chhote qatron (emulsion) mein tod dete hain. In qatron ki surface area bohat badi hoti hai, is liye fat todne wale enzymes achha kaam karte hain.

blocks.title: Jaundice (yarqan)
blocks.text: Agar bile pigments (bile ke rang) digestive tract se bahar na nikal sakein to woh khoon mein jama ho jate hain aur jaundice (peeliya) ho jata hai.
Jejunum aur ileum

Jejunum duodenum ke baad 2.4 metre lamba hissa hai. Ileum chhoti aant ka aakhri, taqreeban teen-panchwan (3/5) hissa hai, yani taqreeban 3.5 metre lamba. In hisson mein baqi digestion aur khane ka absorption hota hai. In ki deewaron mein glands hain jo intestinal juice banati hain. Is juice mein kai enzymes hain: aminopeptidase polypeptides ko dipeptides mein, erepsin dipeptides ko amino acids mein, lipase fats ko fatty acids aur glycerol mein, maltase maltose ko glucose mein, sucrase sucrose ko glucose aur fructose mein, aur lactase lactose ko glucose aur galactose mein todta hai. In enzymes ke baad chyme ek alkaline emulsion ban jata hai jise chyle kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is enzyme ka naam “erypsin” chhapa hai. Sahi naam erepsin hai: yeh intestinal juice ka enzyme hai jo dipeptides ko amino acids mein todta hai.
Hazam shuda khane aur pani ka absorption (jazb hona)

Hazam shuda khana, pani aur ghule hue minerals jejunum aur ileum mein jazb hote hain. In ki andar ki deewar mein badi gol tehein (circular folds) hoti hain. In tehon par ungli jaise bohat se ubhaar hote hain jinhen villi kehte hain.

Har villus mein khoon ki bohat si barik naliyan (blood capillaries) aur lymphatic system ki ek nali hoti hai jise lacteal kehte hain. Capillaries aur lacteal ke upar sirf ek cell moti epithelium (jhilli) hoti hai. Villi ke epithelial cells par bhi be-shumar chhote ubhaar hote hain jinhen microvilli kehte hain. Villi aur microvilli ki wajah se absorption ki kul surface area bohat zyada barh jati hai.

blocks.title: Makhmali satah
blocks.text: Tehon aur bohat si villi ki wajah se jejunum aur ileum ki andar ki satah makhmal (velvet) jaisi lagti hai.

blocks.alt: Aant ki deewar ka tukra jis mein Blood vessels dakhil hoti hain aur tahein Serosa, Longitudinal muscles, Circular muscles, Submucosa aur Mucosa likhi hain; ungli-numa Villi Lumen mein nikli hain. Ek villus bara kiya gaya hai: Epithelial cells use dhanpte hain, surkh aur neela Blood capillaries ka jaal upar neeche chalta hai, aur beech mein Lacteal; sire par teer Absorption of nutrients. Ek epithelial cell jis ki upar ki satah par microvilli hain, aur us ke paar Absorption of nutrients ke teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.7: Aant ki deewar aur villi ki tafseeli banawat (kitab ki Figure 9.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ghiza villus ki ek cell moti epithelium se guzarti hai. Sugar aur amino acids khoon ki capillaries mein jate hain; charbi ke hisse beech wale lacteal (lymph ki nali) mein. Villi aur microvilli surface area ko bohat bada kar dete hain, is liye absorption tez hota hai.

Simple sugars aur amino acids ka absorption: simple sugars (jaise glucose) aur amino acids diffusion ya active transport se villi ke epithelial cells mein jate hain. Wahan se yeh villi ki blood capillaries mein chale jate hain. Villi ki capillaries mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain jo sugars aur amino acids ko liver tak le jati hai. Kitab ke mutabiq liver zaid glucose ko glycogen ki shakal mein aur zaid amino acids ko proteins ki shakal mein rakhta hai. Liver se zaroorat ke mutabiq miqdar hepatic vein ke zariye dil (heart) tak jati hai.

Fatty acids aur glycerol ka absorption: fat ke digestion se bane fatty acids aur glycerol passive transport se villi ke epithelial cells mein jate hain. Villi ke andar yeh dobara mil kar triglycerides bana lete hain. Triglycerides par proteins ki tah chadh jati hai aur is tarah chhote qatre bante hain jinhen chylomicrons kehte hain. Chylomicrons villi ke lacteals mein jate hain, lacteals se thoracic lymphatic duct mein, aur wahan se khoon mein. Blood plasma ke enzymes chylomicrons ko wapas fats aur proteins mein tod dete hain. Aakhir mein fats fatty acids aur glycerol mein toot kar jism ke cells mein chale jate hain.
Large intestine (badi aant)

Yeh alimentary canal ka aakhri hissa hai. Yeh chhoti aant se bohat chhoti hai, aant ka taqreeban aakhri ek metre. Is ka kaam aant ke andar (lumen) se pani, salts aur vitamin K ko khoon mein jazb karna hai. Badi aant pech dar (convoluted) nahi hoti aur is ki andar ki satah par villi nahi hoti. Is ke teen hisse hain.
Cecum

Cecum ek band thaili (blind sac) hai jo ileum aur colon ke beech badi aant se nikalti hai. Is ke band sire se ungli jaisa ek ubhaar nikalta hai jise vermiform appendix kehte hain. Insaan ke digestive system mein appendix koi kaam nahi karta, is liye ise vestigial (bekaar bacha hua) organ kehte hain.

blocks.title: Appendicitis
blocks.text: Appendix ki sozish (inflammation) ko appendicitis kehte hain. Yeh aam tor par bacteria ke infection se hoti hai. Infected appendix ko operation se nikalna zaroori hai, warna yeh phat sakta hai aur sozish pait ki poori andar ki jhilli mein phail sakti hai. Appendix ko operation se nikalne ko appendicectomy kehte hain.
Colon

Cecum ke baad colon hai. Is ke teen hisse hain: ascending (upar jane wala), transverse (aadha, aar paar) aur descending (neeche aane wala). Is ka bada kaam nali se pani jazb karna hai. Pani jazb hone se baqi madda sakht ho jata hai. Yeh waste, faeces (paakhana), bohat se bacteria, hazam na hone wale plant fibres (jaise cellulose), baqi bina hazam khana, utri hui mucosa ke cells, bile pigments aur pani par mushtamil hota hai.
Rectum

Yeh badi aant ka aakhri hissa hai jahan faeces kuch der jama rehte hain. Is ka aakhri sira anus ke zariye bahar khulta hai. Anus ke gird do sphincters (muscle ke chhalle) hain: andar wala smooth muscle ka aur bahar wala striated (skeletal) muscle ka. Jab rectum faeces se bhar jata hai to defecation reflex (paakhane ki khud ba khud khwahish) paida hota hai. Bade log is reflex ko apni marzi se rok sakte hain, magar chhote bachon mein yeh be ikhtiyar (involuntary) hota hai. Barhte hue bacha is reflex ko apne control mein lana seekh leta hai.

Colon mein bohat se bacteria, jaise E. coli, rehte aur taqseem ho kar barhte hain. Apne metabolism mein yeh amino acids aur vitamin K banate hain. Vitamin K insaan ke liye khoon jamne (blood clotting) ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh badi aant se khoon mein jazb hota hai.
Egestion (paakhana nikalne) ka control

Bachon mein paakhane ka be ikhtiyar reflex aur badon mein marzi ka control, nerves aur muscles ki growth ke do marhale hain. Bachon mein egestion spinal cord ke zariye hone wala be ikhtiyar reflex hai: rectum phailta hai to andar wala anal sphincter khud dheela ho jata hai aur faeces nikal jate hain. Aisa is liye hota hai ke dimagh ke woh hisse jo marzi se control karte hain abhi poori tarah nahi bane hote. Badon mein cerebral cortex (dimagh ka bahar wala hissa) mukammal ho jata hai, is liye egestion marzi se hota hai: insaan bahar wale anal sphincter ko jaan boojh kar control kar ke paakhana rok ya shuru kar sakta hai. Yeh tabdeeli dikhati hai ke reflex ke raste aur dimagh ki samajh (cognitive control) mil kar kaam karte hain, taake insaan samaji aur mahol ki zarooraton ke mutabiq chal sake.
Accessory digestive organs (madadgar organs)
1. Liver aur gallbladder

Liver bile bana kar digestion mein bohat aham kirdar ada karta hai; bile fat ke digestion ke liye zaroori hai. Bile fats ko emulsify karta hai, is liye woh aasani se hazam hote hain. Liver chhoti aant se jazb hone wale nutrients ko process bhi karta hai, nuqsan deh cheezon ko be asar (detoxify) karta hai, proteins banata hai aur energy ke liye glycogen jama karta hai.

blocks.title: Gall stones (pitte ki pathri)
blocks.text: Liver se nikla cholesterol gallbladder mein jam kar gall stones (pathri) bana sakta hai, jo bile ka nikalna rok sakti hain.
Gallbladder liver ke banaye hue bile ko jama aur gaadha (concentrate) karta hai. Jab khana chhoti aant mein aata hai to gallbladder bile duct ke zariye bile chhodta hai.
2. Pancreas

Pancreas ek bada gland hai jo stomach ke peeche (dorsal side par), duodenum ke mod mein hota hai. Is ke do hisse hain: exocrine aur endocrine. Exocrine (duct wala) hissa pancreatic juice banata hai jo pancreatic duct mein jata hai. Pancreatic duct liver se aane wali common bile duct se mil kar duodenum mein khulti hai. Pancreatic juice mein har qisam ke khane ko hazam karne wale enzymes hain, jaise trypsin, chymotrypsin, lipases, amylases aur nucleases. Endocrine (bina duct wala) hissa insulin aur glucagon hormones banata hai jo cells ke aas paas ke fluid (extracellular fluid) mein jate hain aur wahan se qareeb ki capillaries (khoon) mein chale jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke pancreas stomach ke “just ventral” (aage) hai. Asal mein insaan mein pancreas stomach ke peeche (dorsal) hota hai, duodenum ke mod mein, jaisa Figure 9.8 mein dikhaya gaya hai.
Pancreas aur liver ke juices ka hormonal control

Hum ne parha ke stomach ke juices nerves aur hormones se control hote hain. Pancreas aur liver ke juices ka nikalna bhi hormones control karte hain. Jab chyme stomach se duodenum mein aata hai to us ki tezabiyat duodenum ki deewar se ek hormone, secretin, nikalwati hai. Isi tarah chyme mein aadhe hazam shuda proteins aur fats duodenum ki deewar se doosra hormone, cholecystokinin (CCK), nikalwate hain. Yeh dono hormones pancreas se pancreatic juice aur gallbladder se bile nikalwate hain.

blocks.alt: Flowchart. Acidic chyme enters the duodenum se Duodenal wall releases secretin; Partly digested proteins and fats in the chyme se Duodenal wall releases CCK. Secretin aur CCK dono ke teer Pancreas releases pancreatic juice aur Gallbladder releases bile dono tak jate hain.
blocks.caption: Pancreatic juice aur bile ka hormonal qaboo (hamara apna flowchart; kitab is jagah koi figure nahin chhapti).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Duodenum ki deewar do hormones banati hai: tezabi chyme se secretin, aur proteins aur fats se cholecystokinin (CCK). Kitab ke mutabiq dono hormones pancreas se pancreatic juice aur gallbladder se bile nikalwate hain, is liye dono teer dono organs tak jate hain; pancreas khud gallbladder ko hukm nahi deta.

blocks.alt: Liver, Stomach aur Spleen ke upar, aur jigar ke neeche Gallbladder. Right hepatic duct aur Left hepatic duct mil kar Common hepatic duct bante hain, jo gallbladder ki Cystic duct se mil kar Common bile duct banti hai aur Duodenum (chhoti aant ka pehla hissa) tak jati hai. Pancreas duodenum ke mor mein hai. Hepatic portal vein aur Hepatic artery jigar tak jati hain.

blocks.text: Bile ka raasta: liver se right aur left hepatic ducts, phir common hepatic duct; yeh cystic duct ke zariye gallbladder se judti hai jahan bile jama hota hai, aur common bile duct bile ko duodenum mein dalti hai. Hepatic portal vein aanton se jazb hui ghiza liver tak lati hai. Pancreas stomach ke peeche, duodenum ke mod mein hai.

Liver ka zakheera (storage) aur metabolism mein kirdar

Liver bohat se aham kaam karta hai, khaas tor par nutrients jama karna aur metabolism ko control karna. Yeh khane se aane wale zaid nutrients jama karta hai aur jab jism ko energy ya banane ka saman chahiye to unhen chhod deta hai. Liver mein jama hone wale nutrients: glucose (glycogen ki shakal mein), vitamins (jaise A, D, B₁₂ aur K), minerals (jaise iron aur copper), aur fats aur fat mein ghulne wali cheezein. Metabolism mein bhi liver ka markazi kirdar hai: yeh jism mein cheezon ko todta, banata aur ek shakal se doosri mein badalta hai. Maslan zaid glucose ko glycogen banata hai aur zaroorat par wapas glucose; fats tod kar energy banata hai aur cholesterol aur lipoproteins banata hai; amino acids ko badalta hai aur nuqsan deh ammonia ko urea mein badal kar nikalta hai, jo peshab (urine) mein kharij hota hai; khoon se zehreeli cheezein (toxins), dawaein aur alcohol tod kar nikalta hai; aur hormones ko todne aur control karne mein bhi madad deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek mareez ki common bile duct pitte ki pathri (gall stone) se band hai. Fat ke digestion, jild (skin) aur pancreatic juice par kya asar hoga? Har ek ki wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Bile salts duodenum tak nahi pohanchenge, is liye fats emulsify nahi honge; lipase un par aasani se kaam nahi kar sakega aur fat ka digestion kam ho jayega. Bile pigments bahar nahi nikal sakenge, khoon mein jama honge aur jaundice (jild aur aankhen peeli) ho jayega. Agar pathri pancreatic duct ke milne se pehle wale hisse mein ho to pancreatic juice phir bhi duodenum tak pohanchega, kyunke secretin aur CCK pancreas ko juice chhodne ka kehte rahenge aur pancreatic duct ka rasta khula hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: GI tract munh se anus tak hai (oral cavity, pharynx, oesophagus, stomach, chhoti aant, badi aant); salivary glands, liver, gallbladder aur pancreas accessory organs hain.

Munh: zaiqe se khana chunna, chabana, aur saliva (pani, mucus, bicarbonate, thiocyanate, salivary amylase jo starch ko maltose banata hai); khana bolus banta hai. Nigalte waqt soft palate naak ka rasta aur epiglottis trachea band karti hai. Peristalsis khana aage le jati hai, segmentation milati hai.

Stomach: muscles ki teen tahein khana mathti hain; gastric glands (mucous, parietal, chief cells) mucus, HCl aur pepsinogen banati hain; pepsin proteins todta hai; chyme pyloric sphincter se aage jata hai. Control: medulla, stomach ka phailna aur pH, gastrin aur somatostatin.

Chhoti aant: duodenum mein pancreatic juice (amylase, trypsin, chymotrypsin, carboxypeptidase, lipase, nucleases) aur bile aate hain; jejunum aur ileum intestinal juice banate aur villi aur microvilli se jazb karte hain: sugars aur amino acids capillaries aur hepatic portal vein mein, fats chylomicrons ban kar lacteals mein.
Badi aant (cecum aur appendix, colon, rectum) pani, salts aur vitamin K jazb karti aur faeces jama karti hai; defecation reflex bachon mein be ikhtiyar aur badon mein marzi se control hota hai.

Liver bile banata, glycogen, vitamins aur minerals jama karta, urea banata aur detoxify karta hai; gallbladder bile jama karta hai; pancreas exocrine (juice) aur endocrine (insulin, glucagon) hai. Duodenum ke secretin aur CCK pancreatic juice aur bile nikalwate hain.
